craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of glory in gear — hand-and-emblem song. Split-un-split bent; point close. Rejected: (a) bent→set → killed: bent aims. Read aloud: MACE, AXE-borne … Ī-ŚĀ-na, YOU-point.

lines: bent on splitting split-un-split, Īśāna, You point.
